BUY CE: PCR>1.2 · Price>EMA21 · VIX<15 · 9:20–10:30 or 13:30–14:30 · ATM/1-OTM · TGT +40% / SL -30%
BUY PE: PCR<0.8 · Price<EMA21 · VIX spike >10% in 15min · ATM/1-OTM
NO TRADE: PCR 0.9–1.1 · VIX>20 · within 30min of expiry-day open
BUY CE: 5-min close crosses ABOVE the up-trendline (pivot-high based, 14-bar lookback, ATR slope decay) · SL = trendline level at cross · TGT +40% premium
BUY PE: 5-min close crosses BELOW the down-trendline (pivot-low based) · SL = trendline level at cross · TGT +40% premium
Trendline recalculates every 5-min candle close. Requires Angel One historical candle access (needs broker login).
BUY CE: Trendline up-break AND (PCR>1.0 OR price>EMA21) — breakout must agree with at least one bullish confirmation
BUY PE: Trendline down-break AND (PCR<1.0 OR price<EMA21) — breakout must agree with at least one bearish confirmation
Trendline breaks WITHOUT confirmation are logged but skipped (no trade) — this is the filter meant to cut false breakouts and raise win rate vs. trendline-alone.

ENTRY: Trendline breakout (5-min) AND candle closes in outer third of its range (real follow-through, not a wick poke) AND ADX(14)>18 (genuinely trending, not chop)

Requires the app tab to stay open — closing it or losing internet stops live firing (and any open live position stays open on the broker's side until you close it yourself).

⚠ SEBI/NSE mandate (effective 1-Apr-2026, all Indian brokers): orders now require a registered static IP — Angel One users register at smartapi.angelone.in → My Profile → My APIs; Zerodha users check the equivalent setting at developers.kite.trade. Most home/mobile connections are dynamic, not static; you may need a static-IP add-on from your ISP. Orders also now use LIMIT, not MARKET — Market/IOC orders are banned for algo trading under this same rule, and a LIMIT order fills at your exact price or not at all, rather than slipping.

STRATEGY:
⚠ Long-Term Investing here scores the technical entry rules only (price vs 200 DMA, Golden Cross, RSI 50–65, volume, 52-week highs). The Fundamental Score (revenue/profit growth, ROE, debt) and Valuation Score (P/E, PEG, EV/EBITDA) from your plan need a fundamentals data source Angel One's API doesn't provide — tell me if you have one (screener.in export, a paid API, etc.) and I'll wire it in. Auto-trades use a wider ±20%/-15% target/SL and auto-close on a Death Cross (50 DMA crossing below 200 DMA), matching your sell rules — staged 30/30/40 entries aren't automated yet, so add follow-on tranches manually for now.
🎯 Trend Pullback buys weakness within strength — an established uptrend (50 DMA above 200 DMA, price above 200 DMA) that has pulled back toward its 20/50-day average with RSI recovering from a dip, rather than chasing a stock at highs. Built for multi-week holds: wider +12%/−6% target/SL (2:1 reward:risk) than the default swing setting, sized like a positional conviction buy.

WIN RATE · REALIZED VS DESIGNED R:R · EXIT BREAKDOWN — PER STRATEGY, PAPER TRADING
What "realized vs designed" means: for winning trades, this compares the average % gain actually captured against the average % gain the trade was designed to reach (its target). A big gap between the two is the signature of a trailing stop cutting winners short before they get near target — exactly what the Aug 2026 trade-history review found (trail-stopped wins averaged +4.5% against designed targets of +18-25%+).
